youtube_title: Ogden Dunes Ski Jump: the giant ski tower on an Indiana sand dune (Portage request)
body: You asked for Portage! Right next door, in Ogden Dunes, thousands of people once stood on a sand dune to watch skiers fly off a tower nearly 200 feet tall. The jump was built in 1927 for what became the Ogden Dunes Ski Club; a state historical marker calls it reputedly the largest artificial ski jump of its day. For five winters, 1928 to 1932, skiers from other countries competed here before crowds of 7,000 to 20,000. Then came the Great Depression and winters with little snow. The meets ended, and the tower was sold to a ski club in Rockford, Illinois, and taken down. A state marker at Kratz Field in Ogden Dunes tells the story; please respect private property. (Sources give the tower's height as 192 to 225 feet.) Comment your town, and it could be next! #Portage #OgdenDunes #PorterCounty #NWI #Indiana #History #LaPorteAfterDark
